build_auto_tokenizer_from_pretrained: build an auto tokenizer from a pretrained model name or local path using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained
load_tokenizer_config_from_path: load tokenizer configuration from a pretrained model path or hub repository
register_custom_tokenizer_class: register a custom tokenizer class with its config class for auto resolution
resolve_tokenizer_class_by_name: resolve a tokenizer class from its string name by searching the internal mapping registry
load_vocab_json_file: load a JSON vocabulary file into a dictionary for tokenizer initialization
